name: Approval without vote
title: RECOMMENDATION FOR SECOND READING on the Council position at first reading with a view to the adoption of a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the implementation of the Single European Sky (recast)
part_text:
The European Parliament approved new rules for managing European airspace, replacing older rules. The aim is to make flights more efficient and better for the environment. The European Commission will set targets for air traffic services on capacity, cost, climate and environment, and check performance at least every three years. A new independent advisory board will help the Commission and Member States decide how to meet these targets. Air traffic service providers and their national supervisors can stay in the same organisation if they are kept functionally separate and independent.

- New EU targets for air traffic on capacity, cost and climate, reviewed at least every three years.
- Affects air traffic service providers, national supervisors and a new advisory board.
- Parliament approved the Council's position, so the law can now be signed and published.
